item: The commodity CSV parse runs off the event loop (audit 0.5.0 A-038, found while measuring A-019)
summary: import_prices_csv called parse_price_csv inside the async handler, so the CPU-bound parse blocked every other request: measured about 44 s at 1.3 M rows (and about 14 s at the 16 MiB cap), 3.99 s at 130,000 rows. It now runs under run_in_threadpool, like the DB half below it. The test spies on asyncio.get_running_loop() inside the parse: it answers on the loop's thread and raises in a worker; red without the change.
